articles.title: Riot to End Active Development for 2XKO in December 2026, Online Play to Remain Unaffected
articles.summary: In one of the more heartbreaking developments in the games industry this year, Riot’s League of Legends fighting game, 2XKO, will officially end active development in December.
body: The writing has been on the wall for some time now, but the official news still hit the fighting game community like a freight train. The 2XKO team explained the situation in a blog post on August 20, admitting that there simply aren’t enough active players to justify continued support.

“Over the last few months, we’ve been monitoring 2XKO’s trajectory closely, and what we’ve seen is painting a clear, consistent picture: while a lot of you jumped in to try the game and there's an incredible community that plays every day, we haven’t seen enough players stick with the game to get to a path toward sustainability,” their post reads.

As of right now, 2XKO will remain online beyond 2026, and offline play will not be affected. The team will continue to introduce new content throughout the rest of the year, including feature improvements, two new champions in Lux and Samira, and a final bug fix patch in December.

It’s unclear if this will remain true in the future, though, as the wording of Riot’s blog post made it seem as though the status of active online play is subject to change. “We’ll give advanced notice if any of that changes,” it reads.

articles.title: Dan Aykroyd Reveals What the Original Ghostbusters Costumes Looked Like
articles.summary: The Ghostbusters almost wore helmets. Franchise co-creator Dan Aykroyd, who also played Ray Stantz, revealed the original costume design for 1984’s Ghostbusters in a post on X. “My original conception for Ghostbusters jumpsuits and packs, illustrated by John Daveikis.
body: The color of the outfit is different from the khaki flightsuits eventually worn in the ‘84 movie. The proton pack is a different size and shape than the final version. The helmet itself looks something like those worn by Rebel pilots in Star Wars.
The Ghostbusters logo is slightly similar to the final, iconic version with a red circle on a black background, inside of which is a white ghost with a red diagonal slash through it.
Aykroyd co-wrote the original Ghostbusters screenplay with Harold Ramis, who would go on to play Egon Spengler. The movie was almost called Ghostblasters or Ghoststoppers due to rights issues.

articles.title: Fortnite Fans Foresee A Five Nights At Freddy’s Crossover, Based On New Building
articles.summary: There has never been a Five Nights at Freddy's collaboration in Fortnite, but an under-construction building on the game's map has given people hope. Well-known leaker HYPEX shared on X that another user named AlignedEclipse has spotted a structure that looks similar to the pizzeria housing Freddy…
body: To further fuel the Five Nights at Freddy's crossover fire, inside this building is a stage, according to AlignedEclipse. The newest season of Fortnite is focused on video games, and it's called Override. Sonic the Hedgehog is part of the game's battle pass, while Mega Man and Crash Bandicoot--among other characters--are planned to come to the game soon. In that regard, Five Nights at Freddy's would fit in with those franchises.

The speculation also posits that maybe the collaboration will time up with Fortnitemares, a yearly event in the battle-royale game based on Halloween. Previously, Five Nights at Freddy's has collaborated with Dead by Daylight, bringing Springtrap and Freddy Fazbear's Pizza to the latter title. However, nothing is official, and it's possible Fortnite is just making something reminiscent of the point-and-click survival-horror game.

Five Nights at Freddy's has recently turned into a successful film franchise, even though the sequel received bear-y bad reviews. Meanwhile, the last game in the series was Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic, which came out last year.

articles.title: Thrilljoy Reveals Terrifying Cute IT: Welcome to Derry Pennywise Figures
articles.summary: Thrilljoy is tackling the HBO series IT: Welcome to Derry for the latest addition to its PIX! line of vinyl toys. If you crave a cutesy yet still oddly terrifying version of killer clowns Pennywise and Periwinkle, you're in luck.
body: In all, there are three figures featured in this blind box line, one standard version and two limited chase variants. The "hero edition" features a classic version of Bill Skarsgård's Pennywise the Dancing Clown and is limited to 9,999 units worldwide.

As for the chase figures, the first is a 1:6 variant that depicts Madeleine Stowe's Ingrid Kersh in her Periwinkle costume. The second is a very rare variant of Pennywise soaked in blood, which is limited to just 96 pieces.
All three figures measure slightly under 5 inches in height. They retail for $20 each, with preorders opening on the Thrilljoy website on August 28 at 8am PT.
IT: Welcome to Derry was recently renewed for a second season on HBO. Based on the finale, we have some ideas for where the series can go next.

articles.title: The New 2026 58" Hisense QD50 Smart TV Offers QLED Image Quality and Built-In Roku for Less Than $200
articles.summary: For students heading back to school, value is paramount. The ideal TV offers a generously sized screen, good image quality, and an easy to use smart interface all at an affordable price.
body: This entry level 2026 Hisense TV offers great image quality that punches above its weight class thanks to Hisense's proprietary Hi-QLED panel with direct-lit LED backlighting. The QD50 officially supports a number of HDR formats including HDR10, Dolby Vision, and HLG. Roku smart interface is also integrated, which is considered one of the best built-in smart interfaces you can get from a budget TV. It's definitely a favorite of mine; I prefer it over Google TV and Fire TV.

The QD50 is also a good TV for gaming on current generation consoles like the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. Although it has a native 60Hz refresh rate instead of 120Hz, the reality is that the vast majority of PS5 games will not run at 120fps. Most games will cap out at 60fps even in performance mode and the select few that can go over usually require a PlayStation 5 Pro console. The money you save on this TV is better spent on more video games.

articles.title: Step Aside, GTA 6 Leaks, We Have To Talk About Zork
articles.summary: Ongoing GTA 6 leaks might be the biggest gaming news story happening right now, but there's something much more important to discuss: Zork. We finally know what From Software's new Switch 2 exclusive, The Duskbloods, actually is, and among the many details we've gotten is a reveal of some of the…
body: That's Zork on the right, a man in an exceedingly pear-like diving suit who wields a hunk of undersea cable as a weapon. He can also howl, fire a cannon carried on his back, and launch his entire body at enemies, which can actually knock enemy players off the map in the ultimate form of humiliation.

In speaking with From Software's Hidetaka Miyazaki recently, our own Jake Dekker had to ask about Zork. "There’s always going to be your traditional characters, especially in a vampire-like game," Miyazaki said. "You have your traditional Victorian Gothic characters, and then you have other characters that are a little bit more off to the side with Asian influences [like Trang Lanh]. I think Zork is basically as far off to the side as you can get, where he’s a bit of a wild card. It’s always fun to have characters like that, and there’s always people who like characters like that."

body: As you can see in the short trailer, Wolverine has a set of serrated claws that he can use in battle. The Rambo influence looks cool, but those extra edges are definitely going to leave a painful mark, even with a mutant healing factor to patch up jagged tissue damage. On the plus side, at least these claws will come in handy whenever Logan needs to slice through a hard crust of bread or slice some cake.

That's a solid selection of costumes, and if Insomniac's work on the Spider-Man games is any sign of what to expect, we're guessing there's a lot more of these suits to unlock during the course of the game. Ahead of its release on September 15, fans can also grab a limited-edition Marvel’s Wolverine PS5 bundle, console covers, and a new DualSense controller inspired by the game. For more, you can check out GameSpot's Marvel's Wolverine preview to read up on how Insomniac is deconstructing the character for a new generation.

articles.title: 5 Classic Nintendo Games that Are Completely Unplayable Today
articles.summary: Nintendo has made decent strides in preservation over the years, either with remakes or by making classic games playable on various services. Nintendo Switch Online's selection of retro games may not include some of the old Virtual Console picks, like Chrono Trigger, but it does rescue dozens of…
body: I could just talk about fun or classic games you can't play now, but that would be boring. So I've picked a selection of games you can't play (currently, easily, accessibly) based on why they're significant and worthy of preservation, and what video game culture is missing without them.

It's a relic of a time when Nintendo governed its biggest brands much less strictly. The company has developed a reputation for Mario and Zelda and the like being top-tier prestige. Every launch is an event, even if it's just a remake. They redefine their respective genres. They're too big to fail. That's not really a bad thing, but it does mask Nintendo's full story. Mario is Missing is an essential reminder of a messier past that should exist alongside the more tightly regulated present.
Plus it's the first time Nintendo got to realize its original dream of giving Mario a gun. If you can drag Virtual Boy games back from hell, you can give Mario his gun again, surely.

articles.title: GTA 6 Leaker Might Have Playable Build Of The Game
articles.summary: Here we go again: A new day means new apparent leaked footage of Grand Theft Auto VI. In fact, one of the latest clips appears to show that the person sharing these videos has access to a playable build of the open-world game.
body: The leaker, who goes by CyberLeek on social media, posted an alleged gameplay video in which Jason Duval shoots at a wall. The bullet marks spell out "LEEK," seemingly proving that CyberLeek has access to a playable build of GTA 6. Before that footage, the video features a blue-and-yellow prop plane flying over what appears to be Vice City. At one point, the game pauses while the player swaps through different radio stations, like V-Rock playing "For What It's Worth" by Stevie Nicks and Back Country Radio playing "Rhinestone Cowboy" by Glen Campbell. There's even Symphony FM.

GTA 6 is set to get an official "Extended Look" trailer exactly a week from today on August 27. That footage will first appear on Netflix on 3 PM ET, before then becoming available on Rockstar's YouTube channel at 9 PM ET. GTA 6 is set to come out November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

articles.title: The Most Completely Bonkers Sci-Fi Action Thriller of 2026 Officially Releases in 3 Weeks
articles.summary: The summer of 2026 isn't technically over until the autumn equinox on Sept. 23, which means there's time for one last big summer blockbuster movie. This year started with some real doubts about the future of the movie theater business, but this summer’s box office has seen huge hits like The…
body: Director Na Hong-jin's Hope is scheduled for an American theatrical release on Sept. 9. If Hope has been flying under your radar so far, it may be worth keeping an eye out for screenings in your area, as the movie has been picking up good buzz and a few positive reviews since the Cannes Film Festival in May.

Hope is set in rural South Korea, where a strange creature is on the loose in the small village of Hope Harbor near the North Korean border. Bum-seok (Hwang Jung-min) and Sung-ae (Hoyeon, Squid Game ) are two of the few cops in the area who aren't occupied with a nearby wildfire, so they’ve got to figure out what’s happening without any chance of backup. At the same time, the creature is being stalked by a group of local hunters.
From there, according to Hope's official writeup at Cannes, "what begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict to a tragedy of cosmic proportions."
Hope also stars Alicia Vikander, Michael Fassbender, Taylor Russell ( Bones and All ), and Cameron Britton ( Mindhunter ).

articles.title: Naruto Live-Action Movie Has Filled a Key Role, Report Says
articles.summary: Fresh off rumors that he'd be joining the Marvel Cinematic Universe's upcoming X-Men reboot as Hank McCoy/Beast, Charles Melton is now in talks to star in a much different sort of role.
body: He's being circled to play Kakashi Hatake, the teacher to Team 7 ninja Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, and Sakura Haruno. Though he starts off as an aloof and indifferent mentor who reads pervy books, Kakashi soon reveals himself to be one of the most skilled and serious ninja in the Hidden Leaf Village. He also has some of the coolest moves, like his signature Chidori attack.

Melton may best be known for his work on The CW's Riverdale series. He's broken out in recent years with roles in May December, Warfare, and Beef season 2, for which he received an Emmy nomination. Cretton's profile has also risen quickly. After directing drama films like The Glass Castle and Just Mercy, he joined the MCU in 2021 with Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings. He's fresh off directing Spider-Man: Brand New Day, which seemingly breaks box office records every second, earning star Tom Holland quite the fat paycheck.

Melton is the first name attached to Cretton's live-action Naruto movie after the director announced a casting search for the Team 7 leads, Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura. According to The Hollywood Reporter, the Naruto movie won't start production until around February 2027.

articles.title: Miyazaki suggests FromSoftware is keen to return to single-player games after The Duskbloods and Elden Ring: Nightreign
articles.summary: Hidetaka Miyazaki, the president of FromSoftware and director of so many revered Soulsian games, has suggested the studio is keen to return to making single-player games after The Duskbloods.
body: Speaking to IGN, Miyazaki explained it was a coincidence that 2025's Elden Ring: Nightreign and The Duskbloods were both multiplayer games. "It's funny because there was never really any big plan that these two games [Nightreign and The Duskbloods] would both release next to each other," he said.

"I mean, that's a different director," he added, referring to Junya Ishizaki who helmed Nightreign, "but both of those ideas just coincided with being multiplayer games. It's not necessarily some big reveal saying that this is the direction we plan to go moving forward. We still have a heavy focus on single-player content as well. This is just something that happened to work out the way it did."

It was while continuing this thought, and saying it had been fun to make a multiplayer game, that Miyazaki said: "But it's like, the more you work on something multiplayer for a long time, if anything, it scratches that itch only to want to make something single-player again."

articles.title: IO Interactive announces new sales milestone for James Bond game 007 First Light
articles.summary: The acclaimed James Bond game 007 First Light continues to find success, with developer IO Interactive announcing today it's passed 4 million sales since launch, just under three months ago.
body: The tally was revealed on social media, with IOI thanking players for their support. The last sales update we had for 007 First Light was much closer to release, when IOI CEO and game director Hakan Abrak said the game had passed 2.7m sales in just over a week on sale.

It's a resounding vote of confidence for the game and studio, especially at a difficult time amidst layoffs caused by the cancellation of the Microsoft Xbox publishing contract related to IOI's other game Project Fantasy.

Naturally, 007 First Light's success also strengthens the likelihood of a sequel in the future. However, if this were to happen, newish James Bond owner Amazon has suggested it would want to be more involved. 007 First Light was self-published by IOI, if you recall.

007 First Light - a game that follows a young, rookie James Bond as he trains in the newly reinstated double-oh programme at MI6 - was widely hailed as a triumphant Bond adaptation. Our own 007 First Light review awarded four stars and called the game "a narrative tour-de-fource".

videos.summary: Bigger Screen. Closer Fear. Once Human (F2P) arrives on PlayStation 5 on August 25.
body: Sit down with Producer Vincent to see how Once Human leverages the power of the PS5 to amplify the thrill of strange worlds survival. Switch seamlessly into the First-Person View and step into pitch-black abandoned buildings, where the fear of the unknown becomes incredibly real.

We’ve deeply adapted the combat experience for your controller. Feel the distinct adaptive trigger resistance with every weapon you fire, and experience nuanced haptic feedback that delivers true recoil right into your hands. Every vibration conveys vital battlefield information against the Anomalous.
Team up with friends, build your territory, and seize power from the anomalies that hunt you.
